title: RunStartedPayload

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

accountId.description: The account the run is billed and authenticated through.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

email.description: The login's email, as the provider's status reports it.

organisation.description: The organisation the login belongs to, when the provider reports one.

anyOf.description: Who an account signed in as: the provider, the email and the organisation when present; one account per identity per environment.

identity.description: Who the account is signed in as, when its status has been read.

effort.description: The reasoning effort asked for; null for the model's own.

anyOf.description: What an agent may do without asking during a run, in the order ceilings use: plan < acceptEdits < auto < bypassPermissions. Claude's default and dontAsk are never used.

requested.description: The mode asked for, by the command or the session; null when neither names one, so a default applied.

effective.description: The mode the run got, after the clamp to the client session's ceiling and the account's modes.

clamped.description: Whether the clamp lowered the mode asked for; run.policy.resolved says why.

mode.description: A run's mode: requested, effective after the ceiling's clamp, and whether it was clamped; run.policy.resolved has the rest.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine.

workspace.description: Where a session's code lives on its environment: its kind and path.

origin.description: Where a run came from: client (runs.start or runs.send, or the environment's queue after a client's run), routine, completions, or provider (a turn the provider opened itself, adopted as a run).

anyOf.description: A user message's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when a client sends it, and the id the provider is handed.

promptMessageId.description: The message the run starts with; null for a run that starts with queued messages only.

items.description: A user message's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when a client sends it, and the id the provider is handed.

queuedMessageIds.description: Queued messages the run reads as its prompt, in order: the environment's queue, or what a provider-opened turn opened with.

resumedFrom.description: The provider's session id the run resumes; null for a fresh one.

anyOf.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

forkedFrom.description: The session the run's session was forked from, on a fork's first run; else null.

description: run.started: a run of the session started; its startedAt is the event's occurredAt.
